In this exact 1672x941 image, each standing adult must be only 50-60 pixels from feet to head, NOT 150-180px. Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: documentary living projection, rome_round11_prayer2020.png. EDIT the attached native 3D MODEL into the SAME camera view of St Peter's Square during the rainy evening of 27 March 2020. The attached image is the edit target and absolute geometry reference. Keep exact camera position, lens, framing and horizon; every building, visible roofline, wall, palace block, basilica facade and dome, colonnade curve and individual supports, obelisk and street opening remain at exactly the same position and size. No crop, zoom, new viewpoint or rearranged skyline. Deliver the same landscape 16:9 framing, ideally 1920x1080. The many white blocks around the square ARE THE EXISTING BORG0 / VATICAN CITY BUILDINGS, do not erase or reduce them. Paint their present urban masonry, plaster and restrained roof materials while preserving every silhouette. Keep the basilica's existing giant columns and central upper loggia opening visible and aligned. Lilac/purple/white model colours are visualization only: all structures use natural pale warm travertine, real grey or muted weathered dome material, ochre/cream urban plaster and restrained earth-coloured roofs.
Event: rainy dusk, a dark blue-grey overcast sky, visible fine rain, a quietly EMPTY SQUARE without visitors or a crowd. Wet stone paving reflects a few restrained warm lights. The paving texture and individual joints must remain clearly visible through reflections; uneven local shallow rain sheen, NOT a continuous mirror lake. At the distant basilica entrance place one small lit temporary canopy and ONE very small white-robed praying figure, proportionate to the entrance and seen without a face or identifiable portrait detail. No extra group of clergy, security line, vehicles or ceremony crowd.
Surroundings are CRITICAL: All dark bare land outside and between the native buildings is CONTINUOUS URBAN LAND with actual pavement, streets and sparse real planting, NOT WATER. Retain the Vatican palace beside the basilica and the visible dense Borgo blocks beyond both colonnades; the existing Via della Conciliazione approach runs through the lower foreground wherever visible in this exact view. Model slabs are ground areas to continue as paving, not floating islands with edges. Ground stays connected under the colonnade and around the palace. There is NO RIVER, LAKE, HARBOUR, SHORELINE, POOL or FLOOD anywhere in this frame. Do not replace buildings with countryside, water or forest. Rain falls on dry-land urban surfaces, causing a thin reflective wet sheen ONLY, never water around column bases or water swallowing streets.
Look: natural materials, restrained well-lit documentary realism with very light painterly texture, consistent with approved Rome historical living images. Intimate solemn quiet within a still inhabited built city. Rain and dusk are legible without excessive darkness or theatrical spectacle. No giant people, portrait closeups, bright sunny sky, altered architecture, news logos, lettering, caption, watermark or border.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: documentary living projection, final rome_round11_piazza_pia2024.png. EDIT THE ATTACHED NATIVE 3D MODEL; use it as an absolute camera and geometry reference. Deliver the SAME landscape 16:9 framing, ideally 1920x1080. Keep exact camera, lens, horizon height, every building footprint, facade plane, outline, height, street opening, distant Saint Peter's silhouette and size, every tree location and each of the TWO low oval fountain basins. Nothing is moved, cropped, zoomed or replaced with another view. The final camera stands INSIDE PIAZZA PIA and looks west into Via della Conciliazione towards the distant basilica. It is late December 2024, an ordinary winter day after the new pedestrian square opened, not a ceremony.
Replace model surfaces with natural Roman materials: warm grey and pale cream stone pedestrian paving with believable large-slab joints, restrained ochre/cream urban plaster, grey stone bases, natural roof materials. Saint Peter's is pale warm cream/grey stone and a muted weathered dome, never lilac, purple or a glowing white model. Retain the very tall close building faces at the sides and their exact perspective, with modest believable windows/doors treated as surface details, no added balconies, wings or floors. Render the modelled trees at their exact positions and crown volumes as restrained believable winter urban planting, not large new canopies. The TWO existing low oval rings are shallow fountain basins: keep their exact shapes, positions and low edges. Calm water may be visible ONLY INSIDE those two existing basins; no added jets, sculptural fountain or new pool. Keep the central walking route open.
Life: a few naturally spaced anonymous adults and a family in plain winter coats, mostly walking away or in profile along the existing paved square towards Via della Conciliazione / Saint Peter's; one or two people may come the other way. Ordinary true human scale in relation to the modelled basins, trees and doorways, no oversized figures, posing, recognizable face or crowd. Soft winter daylight, clear legible materials, restrained documentary realism with very light painterly texture matching the approved Rome living pictures.
CRITICAL GROUND CONSTRAINT: THE ENTIRE LOWER HALF IS CONTINUOUS STONE PEDESTRIAN PAVING AND THE TWO ALREADY-MODELLED FOUNTAIN BASINS. THE TIBER AND ITS HIGH LUNGOTEVERE EMBANKMENT ARE BEHIND THE CAMERA, ENTIRELY OUTSIDE THIS FRAME. DO NOT ADD A RIVER, SHORELINE, CANAL, QUAY, BEACH, PARAPET OR EMBANKMENT ANYWHERE IN THIS IMAGE. The bare dark patches in the model are land/urban pavement, not river water. Do not turn the square into a waterfront or cut the paving along a guessed waterline. No surface vehicles across the connection, invented tunnel portal, new buildings, extra fountains, trees not in the reference, ceremony, flags, officials, Pope, ribbon cutting, 2025 event or parade, branded signs, logos, text, watermark or border.
